description: This route around Hythe uses the Elham Valley Way to create a circular walk around the town. You'll follow the waymarked trail north from Hythe into the surrounding countryside before returning to the coast via Brockhill Country Park and the Royal Military Canal Path. The trail uses good, waymarked paths additionally visiting Etchinghill and Ashley Wood. There are some splendid views over the countryside and coast to enjoy from the high points.
